note: WHO recommends sun protection from UV Index 3.
context: Higher UV levels can harm skin and eyes sooner. Time outdoors also matters.

levels.label: Low UV
actions: At UV Index 0-2, you can enjoy being outdoors.
Fresh snow and other bright surfaces can add reflected UV.

levels.label: Protection recommended
actions: Cover exposed skin, and wear a wide-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses.
Use broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously on uncovered skin. Reapply every two hours and after swimming or sweating.

levels.label: Extra protection
actions: If possible, limit time outdoors around midday and seek shade when outside.
Cover exposed skin, and wear a wide-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses.
Use broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously on uncovered skin. Reapply every two hours and after swimming or sweating.
